expo.name: ChainDay

infoPlist.NSUserNotificationsUsageDescription: ChainDay sends reminders you choose (habit check-ins, streak alerts, and scheduled motivation messages) to help you stay consistent.

expo.description:
Transform your life with beautiful habit tracking. ChainDay makes building habits stick with powerful chain visualizations, streak tracking, and smart daily suggestions.

KEY FEATURES:

✨ Chain Visualization
Watch your habits grow as connected chains. Visual motivation that makes you never want to break the streak.

📊 Habit Strength Algorithm
Track how strong your habits actually are. The more consistent you are, the stronger they become.

🎯 Time-Based Suggestions
Get smart habit suggestions based on your time of day - morning energy boosters, afternoon focus, evening relaxation.

🎮 Gamification & Achievements
Earn XP, level up, and unlock achievements as you build your routine. Progress feels rewarding.

📅 Week & Calendar Views
See your progress at a glance with beautiful weekly overviews and calendar visualizations.

🔔 Smart Reminders
Set custom notifications for each habit. Gentle nudges at the right time keep you on track.

📝 Notes & Journaling
Add notes to each habit to reflect on your journey and track what works best.

🌙 Vision Board
Create a visual representation of your goals and inspirations to stay motivated.

🔒 Privacy First
Your data stays secure. We never sell your information or track you for advertising.

PERFECT FOR:
- Building morning and evening routines
- Fitness and workout tracking
- Meditation and mindfulness habits
- Reading and learning goals
- Healthy eating and hydration
- Skill development
- Daily productivity
- Sleep optimization

WHY CHAINDAY?
Simple, beautiful, and designed for real life. No complex setup, no overwhelming features - just what you need to build habits that actually stick.

Start your streak today. Download ChainDay and see how far you can go!
